method: Exact enumeration of centered, paired, rounded/clipped historical score residuals from CookGameOdds.nflGame; strict earlier-week filtering. Target rest/travel context only. Realized target weather excluded.
limits: Retrospective audit, not independent prospective validation.
Historical forecast-weather snapshots unavailable; production weather conditioning is not evaluated.
Historical lines are closing proxies, not verified execution prices.
Binary Brier scores exclude actual pushes and condition simulation probability on no push.
